items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: I liked him as an opera conductor.

ctx.x: Well, you asked me to ask you about Walter Herbert, who is he?

Walter Herbert? Oh, he conducted the opera orchestra here in New Orleans for many years. In fact, he was practically the business manager too. And when they hardly had any money, you know, I think he managed it very well. And if we have an opera orchestra in New Orleans, an opera company in New Orleans today, I think he's to thank for it. Because of his iron fist was money. And he was, and a fine orchestra conductor too. Throw cue at musicians, throw cues at singers, everything. He was very good. I liked him as…
Who's this fellow, Fontana, you asked me?
